 ENDF/B-VI format                                                  700 1451   12

 ================================================================= 700 1451   34
  Warning                                                          700 1451   35
 ================================================================= 700 1451   36
  MF/MT combinations used to define photoionization subshell cross 700 1451   37
  sections (MF=23, MT=534-572) and coherent anomalous scattering   700 1451   38
  factors (MF=27, MT=505 AND 506) are newly defined MF/MT numbers  700 1451   39
  for ENDF/B-VI that did not exist in earlier versions of ENDF/B.  700 1451   40
  If you are not prepared to use this data you need merely delete  700 1451   41
  it and all of the remaining data will still be consistent and    700 1451   42
  equivalent to the types of data in earlier versions of ENDF/B.   700 1451   43
  However, this will limit the range of problems to which this     700 1451   44
  data can be applied (see: ref. 1 for details).                   700 1451   45
 ================================================================= 700 1451   46
  Definition of new types of data                                  700 1451   47
 ================================================================= 700 1451   48
  1) The total photoionization cross section is equal to the sum   700 1451   49
     of the photoionization subshell cross sections.               700 1451   50
                                                                   700 1451   51
     For each subshell on the second line of a section the C1 and  700 1451   52
     C2 fields are defined as,                                     700 1451   53
                                                                   700 1451   54
     EPE = The photoionization edge energy (similar to Q-value)    700 1451   55
     EFL = The fluorescence yield (eV/photoionization)             700 1451   56
                                                                   700 1451   57
  2) The angular distribution of coherently scattered photons is,  700 1451   58
                                                                   700 1451   59
     S(E,MU) = 3*T/8*(1 + MU**2)*((FF(M)+F1(E))**2+(F2(E))**2)     700 1451   60
                                                                   700 1451   61
     S(E,MU) = Angular distributions (barns per unit cosine)       700 1451   62
     T       = The Thomson cross section                           700 1451   63
     MU      = The cosine of the scattering angle                  700 1451   64
     FF(M)   = The atomic form factor                              700 1451   65
     M       = Momentum transfer = SIN(THETA/2)/LAMBDA/4*PI        700 1451   66
     F1(E)   = The real anomalous scattering factor                700 1451   67
     F2(E)   = The imaginary anomalous scattering factor           700 1451   68
                                                                   700 1451   69
     F1(E) and F2(E) are isotropic.                                700 1451   70
                                                                   700 1451   71
     When F1(E) = F2(E) = 0 this reduces to the result obtained    700 1451   72
     using only form factors (the older ENDF/B convention).        700 1451   73
 ================================================================= 700 1451   74
 Differences between EPDL97 and the data base presented here       700 1451   75
 ================================================================= 700 1451   76
 1) Energy range - EPDL97 - 1 eV to 100 GeV                        700 1451   77
                   Here   - 1 eV TO 100 GeV (previously 100 MeV)   700 1451   78
 2) Type of Data - EPDL97 - Photon interaction including           700 1451   79
                            photoexcitation                        700 1451   80
                   Here   - Photon interaction  - ENDF/B-VI has    700 1451   81
                            no provision for photoexcitation       700 1451   82
 3) Secondary E  - EPDL97 - Average energy of each secondary       700 1451   83
                            (photons, electrons, positrons)        700 1451   84
                   HERE   - No secondary energy data               700 1451   85
 4) Interpolation- EPDL97 - Cross sections are Log X vs. Log Y     700 1451   86
                            interpolable - the total cross         700 1451   87
                            section is not included                700 1451   88
                          - Form factors and scattering functions  700 1451   89
                            are Log X vs. Log y, except first      700 1451   90
                            interval.                              700 1451   91
                          - Anomalous scattering factors linearly  700 1451   92
                            interpolable (they can be negative)    700 1451   93
                   Here   - Up through ENDF/B-V photon interaction 700 1451   94
                            cross sections were Log X vs. Log Y.   700 1451   95
                          - For the first two Mods. of ENDF/B-VI   700 1451   96
                            in order to consistently define the    700 1451   97
                            total cross sections at ALL energies   700 1451   98
                            all cross sections were linearized.    700 1451   99
                            This was NOT a good idea.              700 1451  100
                          - Starting with Mod. 3, cross sections   700 1451  101
                            are left in Log X vs. Log. Y form so   700 1451  102
                            that they are IDENTICAL to what's in   700 1451  103
                            EPDL97.                                700 1451  104
                            The total is defined ONLY at the       700 1451  105
                            energies tabulated in any other cross  700 1451  106
                            section.                               700 1451  107
                 WARNING  - As a result the total cross section    700 1451  108
                            MUST NOT be interpolated to define the 700 1451  109
                            total between tabulated energies. The  700 1451  110
                            ONLY consist way to define the total   700 1451  111
                            between tabulated energies is to       700 1451  112
                            interpolate all of the partials and    700 1451  113
                            add them up.                           700 1451  114
